verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an API reference page describing programmatic access to projects, experiments, datasets, traces, prompts and scorers. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive (try-it consoles, runnable request examples), and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. A static API reference is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward an interactive, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
